headline: UK Offshore Assets Exceed £1 Trillion as HMRC Data Reveals 10% Rise
summary: UK taxpayers hold more than £1 trillion in offshore tax havens following a recent 10% rise, according to HM Revenue and Customs data. The figures have raised concerns over potential losses to public revenue.
why: HM Revenue and Customs is the UK government department responsible for tax collection and enforcement.

impacts.name: United Kingdom
impacts.why: A rise in offshore asset holdings by UK taxpayers signals potential losses in domestic tax revenues.
